gift_policy.policy_text: Employees may not accept gifts valued over $50 from vendors, clients, or external parties without prior written approval from the Ethics & Compliance office. Cash and cash equivalents (gift cards, vouchers) are prohibited regardless of value. Modest courtesy gifts that employees personally purchase for external recipients are permitted when valued at or below $50 and are not cash equivalents. All accepted gifts must be reported within 5 business days using the gift disclosure form.
restriction_notes: Cash and cash-equivalent gifts are strictly prohibited.
Gifts from regulated vendors require written pre-approval.
Employee-purchased courtesy gifts to external recipients are permitted up to $50.
Disclosure form must be submitted within 5 business days.
